text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin got injured during 
training, so I brought her to the 
infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...Like I said, you're making a big deal 
out of nothing. An injury like this will 
heal fine on its own."
choice_data_list: It'd be bad if it got worse.
It'd be awful if it got worse.
Got it! Let's get back to training!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...Like I said, you're making a big deal 
out of nothing. An injury like this will 
heal fine on its own."
choice_data_list: It'd be bad if it got worse.
It'd be awful if it got worse.
Got it! Let's get back to training!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Shut. Up!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Do I really look that weak to you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Is it 'cause I'm smaller than the others?! 
'Cause my body's skinny and frail?!
choice_data_list: I'm worried about Taishin, you know

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'm telling you, nobody asked for your 
help!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
If you've got time to worry, why don't you 
come up with a training menu instead?
choice_data_list:
If I think of something, will you treat 
it?

If I think of something, will you treat 
it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was all fired up, saying I'd come up 
with as many ideas as needed, but then—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not what I meant! Were you even 
listening?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...Sigh. This is starting to feel 
completely ridiculous."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin, looking completely 
drained, then allowed herself to be 
treated for her injury.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking that she must understand her own 
body best, I decided to trust Narita 
Taishin's words.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. You should've just said so from the 
start.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Haa, hah...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: —Kh!!
choice_data_list: It's that injury from earlier after all...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Shut up...! I can keep going!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I can still run! I have to... I must keep 
running...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I can understand Narita Taishin's 
impatience, but letting her keep running 
like this is dangerous.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, I managed to calm her down and 
ended training early.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa... How's that?!
choice_data_list:
Looks like that injury is really nothing 
to worry about.

Looks like that injury is really nothing 
to worry about, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Of course. I can't let something like that 
stop me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
If you wanna beat the others, you've got 
no choice but to train more than anyone 
else.
choice_data_list:
Still, I want you to take good care of 
your body.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: *Sigh*... You really are a busybody.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Come on, stop arguing and just let me 
train.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...If I get stronger, you won't have to 
worry so much, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, despite Narita Taishin's 
constant complaining, we managed to 
complete the training all the way through.
